raw_posts.name: TestSprite 4.0
raw_posts.tagline: Fix one thing, break another? This agent checks it all
raw_posts.description: Your coding agent fixes one thing and breaks another. TestSprite 4.0 is a brand-new testing agent that remembers what your app should do and checks all of it, every time. Tell it in plain words what to test. It explores your running app, writes and runs the end-to-end tests, tells you which failures are real bugs, and keeps checking every change from the web, your terminal or your pull requests.

raw_posts.name: Verse Engine by Ctruh
raw_posts.tagline: Blender, Unity or Unreal to a live 3D link in one click
raw_posts.description: Verse Engine by Ctruh is a browser-native 3D and XR engine that turns any 3D into one link. Bring files, scans and floor plans, or publish straight from Blender, Unity and Unreal. The link opens in any browser with no app and no download. Built for developers, 3D artists, game studios, architects, real estate teams and e-commerce brands. A scene streams only what the viewer sees, so a 10.3 billion triangle city opens from a link on a laptop. Embeds, API and SDK included. Free 14-day Pro trial.

raw_posts.name: Netlify Server
raw_posts.tagline: Run WebSockets, multiplayer apps, and long-running agents
raw_posts.description: Netlify Server gives your app a backend that stays alive while people are using it. Build realtime experiences, multiplayer games, and AI agents that need time to finish. Describe what you want and an agent builds it, or bring your Express, Fastify, Hono, or Koa code. It holds WebSockets open, keeps state in memory, and deploys with the rest of your project, with its own server for every preview. Scales with demand and down to zero when idle. Free during early access.

raw_posts.name: Stripo Email Widgets
raw_posts.tagline: Put a game, quiz or survey in your next email. No coding
raw_posts.description: Put a scratch card, quiz, poll, NPS survey or event agenda into your email. Drag a widget into the Stripo editor, then tell the AI Assistant what to change: text, colors, questions, prizes. Each of the 20+ widgets comes with its design, interaction and fallback logic built in. It plays where the inbox supports interactivity and shows a clean static block where it doesn't. Save the container and reuse it in any template. Available on every plan, including Free.

raw_posts.name: Adside
raw_posts.tagline: A team of specialized AI agents that manage paid ads for you
raw_posts.description: A team of specialized AI agents that manage your paid ads on Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit and Twitter. Run it yourself, or have one of our human experts manage it for you.

raw_posts.name: Manufact
raw_posts.tagline: Ship and test your MCP to every plugin marketplace
raw_posts.description: Manufact helps teams publish MCP servers and plugins, understand how agents use them, and test releases across clients. Bring publishing checks, session traces and cross-client tests into one workflow.

raw_posts.name: Spellar for Chrome
raw_posts.tagline: Free, no-bot meeting notes with memory, now in your browser
raw_posts.description: Spellar for Chrome takes no-bot meeting notes on Windows and Mac, right in your browser, with no desktop app to install. It records Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex, and nothing joins the call. On Google Meet, transcripts show real speaker names. Every call goes into one memory with your Spellar Mac and iPhone notes, so you can ask what a client said three calls ago. Send notes to Slack or Notion and pick Claude, GPT or Gemini. Start with 300 free minutes, no card needed.

raw_posts.name: Tabstack by Mozilla
raw_posts.tagline: Give your model the web without giving up your privacy
raw_posts.description: Research, extract, and automate the web from one managed API. Get a cited answer, clean text, matching JSON, or a completed browser task from the live web in one call. We run the browsers and the web loop outside your model, so you build your agent without building its web stack. Never trained on. Private by default. Built by Mozilla. Start free with 10,000 credits.

raw_posts.name: Teaflask
raw_posts.tagline: Self-improving AI copilot for your app. No backend changes.
raw_posts.description: Turn your existing SaaS into an AI-native product without rebuilding your backend. Teaflask adds a managed AI copilot that lets users get things done by simply asking. Integrate through your frontend, use your own UI components, and go live in a day. Teaflask keeps its product knowledge grounded in your code, learns from real usage, and lets you test changes before release.

raw_posts.name: Gemini 4 Neon
raw_posts.tagline: Frontier reasoning with faster task completion
raw_posts.description: Gemini 4 Neon brings frontier-level reasoning to faster coding, research, and agent workflows. Adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon, it supports multimodal inputs and a 1M-token context window, with access through the Gemini API, AI Studio, and Antigravity.
